'''Raymond Félix Stora''' (18 September 1930 – 20 July 2015<ref name=FAS-bio/>) was a French theoretical physicist.  He was  a researcher at [[:fr:Institut_de_physique_théorique_-_IPhT_Saclay|Service de Physique Théorique]] at [[CEA Paris-Saclay|CEA Saclay]], then a research director at the French [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|National Centre for Scientific Research]] (CNRS) at CPT Marseille and at LAPP Annecy, as well as a member of [[CERN]]'s theory group.  His work focused on [[particle physics]].<ref name=FAS-bio />

Stora studied at the [[École Polytechnique]] from 1951 to 1953, and then at [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] (MIT), where he received a doctorate in 1958 under the supervision of [[Victor Weisskopf]].  Stora's most influential contribution to physics was his work with [[Carlo Becchi]] and [[Alain Rouet]] on a rigorous mathematical procedure for quantizing non-Abelian [[Gauge theory|gauge field theories]], which dates from the mid 1970s and is now known as [[BRST quantization]].

Stora was elected as a correspondent to the physics section of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] in 1994.<ref name=FAS-bio>{{cite news| last=Zinn-Justin | first=Jean | author-link=Jean Zinn-Justin |title=Raymond Stora - Obituary| publisher=Académie des sciences | url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/In-memoriam/raymond-stora.html | language=fr | date=July 2015}}</ref>  In 2009, he was awarded the [[Dannie Heineman Prize for Mathematical Physics]].<ref name=Sacco>{{cite web | url=http://www.futura-sciences.com/magazines/matiere/infos/actu/d/physique-raymond-stora-laureat-prix-dannie-heineman-physique-mathematique-17364/ | title=Raymond Stora, lauréat du Prix Dannie Heineman de Physique Mathématique | publisher=Futura - Sciences | date=November 18, 2008 | accessdate=July 12, 2013 | author=Sacco, Laurent| language=French}}</ref> CNRS held a special conference in his honour some months after his 80th birthday.<ref>{{cite news| title=Conference Raymond Stora - a special day in honour of Raymond Stora| website=CNRS| date=8 July 2011| url=https://lapth.cnrs.fr/conferences/RaymondStora/information/program.html}}</ref>
